why: Standard searches show the problem still open with bounds unchanged (2d+1 <= nu(d) < 2d + ceil((d+1)/2)). A Nov 2025 AlphaEvolve paper (arXiv:2511.02864) reports improved solutions on a list of 67 math problems spanning geometry/combinatorics, and search summaries speculated the McMullen problem might be among them, but I could not confirm this against the actual problem list without reading the paper/repository, which is out of scope for this pass.
